subject.title: [Feature]: Support Slack Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept an explicit opt-in Slack Enterprise Grid org-install mode in the bundled Slack plugin via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102372, or keep the current per-workspace account model for now?
rationale: The request adds config surface and changes Slack workspace authorization, routing, delivery, and state boundaries; the issue also has a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide this product/security direction.

options.title: Review linked PR as candidate
options.body: Treat the open Slack PR as the implementation path and require config, upgrade, authorization-boundary, and live org-install proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to per-workspace accounts
options.body: Keep the current model until maintainers choose an OAuth or multi-account design with clearer upgrade and security proof.

options.title: Reject org-install scope for now
options.body: Close the direction only if maintainers decide Enterprise Grid org installs should stay outside the bundled Slack plugin.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as candidate
recommendation.body: Treat the open Slack PR as the implementation path and require config, upgrade, authorization-boundary, and live org-install proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current local history points to Vincent Koc as a relevant Slack config/context contributor for routing this product/security choice.
